name: dodo-vscode
description: Dodo language support: highlighting, diagnostics, quick fixes, type inlay hints, completion, navigation, rename, and formatting.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting and snippets are available. The Dodo language server runs only in trusted workspaces.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting and snippets are available. The language server requires local files or untitled documents.

dodo.server.enabled.description: Enable the Dodo language server. Highlighting and snippets are always available.

dodo.server.path.markdownDescription: Dodo executable name on PATH or a path to the compiler. Relative paths and `${workspaceFolder}` resolve against the first workspace folder. The extension supplies the `lsp` argument; do not include arguments or shell quotes.

enumDescriptions: Check each open file and its imports.
Check each open file's parent directory as a package, including unsaved siblings.
dodo.checkMode.description: Diagnostic checking mode. Changing this setting restarts the server.

dodo.buildTarget.description: Named target from dodo.toml for diagnostics and platform imports. Empty uses the project default. Changing this setting restarts the server.

dodo.manifestPath.description: Project manifest path, absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. Empty discovers dodo.toml in that folder. Changing this setting restarts the server.

dodo.target.description: LLVM target triple for diagnostics and platform imports (for example wasm32-unknown-unknown). Empty uses the selected manifest target, otherwise the host target. Changing this setting restarts the server.

dodo.trace.server.description: LSP trace detail. To enable tracing, set the Dodo Language Server output channel's log level to Trace using Developer: Set Log Level.
